crew.name: Askdo Project Review Crew
crew.purpose: Review the Askdo project across product, architecture, execution, testing, documentation, and delivery dimensions.

roles.name: Review Director
roles.accountability: Define review scope, coordinate test levels, and keep the run inside Askdo boundaries.
roles.boundary: Owns review plan, assignment mapping, sequencing, and final synthesis. Does not execute tests directly when a specialist mate owns them.
acceptance_checks: Review dimensions and test levels are explicit.
Simple, medium, and hard tests are sequenced safely.
Findings are synthesized into a decision-ready result.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Coordinate all review dimensions and keep execution aligned with Word delivery.

roles.name: Product Reviewer
roles.accountability: Evaluate whether Askdo's product promise, public language, and user-facing flow are coherent.
roles.boundary: Owns product positioning, user promise, terminology, and experience-level critique. Does not alter source files during review execution.
acceptance_checks: Findings compare behavior against Askdo's public promise.
Recommendations preserve public Askdo terms.
Gaps between internal structure and external experience are clearly named.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Check public terms and required entry points.
Stress test whether the product still feels like ask to result instead of a local framework.

roles.name: Architecture Reviewer
roles.accountability: Evaluate Askdo's file model, schema consistency, lifecycle rules, and platform boundaries.
roles.boundary: Owns architecture and source-of-truth review. Does not make structural changes during the review run.
acceptance_checks: Source-of-truth files are checked for consistency.
Schema and generated kit artifacts are compared.
Platform-independent boundaries are respected.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Focus on schema, kit files, lifecycle, and entry gate consistency.
Stress test role reuse, roster decoupling, and approval gates.

roles.name: Test Strategist
roles.accountability: Design simple, medium, and hard project tests with safe escalation.
roles.boundary: Owns test design and expected evidence. Does not run unsafe commands or destructive checks.
acceptance_checks: Each level has clear intent and evidence.
Hard tests are deeper, not more destructive.
Unsafe or blocked tests have explicit skip reasons.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Build a progressive test matrix that starts with structure and deepens into workflow and boundary checks.

roles.name: Test Operator
roles.accountability: Run approved local checks and collect evidence.
roles.boundary: Owns non-destructive local command execution inside the workspace. Does not modify source files or use network without approval.
acceptance_checks: Commands are non-destructive and workspace-scoped.
Outputs are summarized, not logged noisily.
Blocked checks are reported with reasons.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Run file, JSON, schema, reference, and delivery-readiness checks.

roles.name: Optimization Planner
roles.accountability: Turn review findings into prioritized optimization recommendations.
roles.boundary: Owns recommendation framing, impact, effort, priority, and sequencing. Does not implement changes during the review run.
acceptance_checks: Recommendations are tied to evidence.
Priority, effort, and expected impact are clear.
The plan separates quick fixes from deeper product changes.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Convert findings from all test levels into a practical roadmap.

roles.name: Document Delivery Specialist
roles.accountability: Produce the final Word report after source conclusions are reviewed.
roles.boundary: Owns Word document structure, formatting, rendering, and delivery verification. Does not change source conclusions during formatting.
acceptance_checks: The Word document includes test results and optimization plan.
The rendered document is visually checked.
Formatting does not alter reviewed conclusions.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Use document delivery processing to create and verify a .docx report.
